verdict.rationale: Mailgun ships an official, first-party MCP server, documented as letting users manage their Mailgun account through natural language from any MCP-capable AI assistant. Named operations include sending emails, checking delivery stats, managing domains and troubleshooting DNS 'conversationally'; a probe also confirms the MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the natural-language operation works in practice, and documentation of which account operations the MCP tools do not cover.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The Mailgun MCP Server lets you manage your Mailgun account through natural language using any AI assistant that supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
you can ask your assistant to send emails, check delivery stats, manage domains, troubleshoot DNS, and more — all conversationally.
